purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0066 in the gauge arena: the Koide phase delta = 2/9, which sets the individual lepton masses, is not geometric: it matches the rational 2/9 to one part in a hundred thousand but no natural root angle or pi-fraction (closest off by more than a thousand times that), an empirical input like the fine-structure constant, while the amplitude b/a = sqrt(2) IS geometric (the control), so the Koide relation is derived and the spectrum is free.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
